message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red background and white circular center. The large black word "TEMPO" is at the top. Below it, the text "23-29 MARET 2015" appears in white. At the very top, white text reads "BERDARAH-DARAH KARENA DOLAR / PERJAMUAN TERLARANG HAKIM AGUNG".

An illustration of a man dominates the center. He wears a dark navy blue long-sleeved suit resembling a martial arts uniform, a black headpiece with a pointed fabric fold, and a light gray sash around his waist. He is barefoot, in a wide-legged crouching stance. His right hand is raised with palm open and fingers extended, while his left hand is clenched into a fist at chest height. His facial features include glasses and a mustache. 

Diagonal red text "KUDA-KUDA KALLA" crosses his legs. Below this, white text reads: "TAK DILIBATKAN DALAM PENGAMBILAN SEJUMLAH KEPUTUSAN PENTING, JUSUF KALLA MERAPATKAN BARISAN. MEMPERSOALKAN KANTOR STAF PRESIDEN."

The bottom left corner contains "RP 39.500", a website, and a barcode.
